name: track_wal_io_timing
description: Enables collection of timing statistics for WAL I/O operations, including read and write latency.
symptoms: Inability to identify WAL-related I/O bottlenecks
Misleading performance reports from monitoring tools
tuning_tips: Enable only when diagnosing WAL I/O latency issues; disable otherwise as it adds minor overhead to every WAL I/O operation.
